title: 情報工学応用
subtitle: Applied Information and Computer Science
keywords: Real-world application of information technology 2.Information infrastructure technology 3.Solution & Service 4.Regional cooperation
educationalGoal: Learn about the application paths to many technology groups that support the information and communications industry, namely information network technology, web service & cloud technology, information security technology, human interface technology, and embedded technology.
advice: It is important to accurately grasp the situation in which information and communication technology has advanced remarkably and its usage is changing rapidly. In particular, major technological innovations often lead to transitions to new technology platforms. In order to follow these changes and not fall out, it is important to understand the basic concept and handling of technology. Learn how basic technology is applied and developed in the real world from faculty members of the department and specialists representing each field.
books: Textbooks: None Reference books: None Reserved books: None
requiredKnowledge: Students are expected to review specialized subjects learned in this department

activityGoals.body: Be able to utilize expertise in information and communication technology infrastructure to tackle practical
Be able to use practical knowledge of web services & the cloud to tackle practical issues.
Be able to use practical knowledge on information security to tackle practical service construction issues.
Be able to use human interface expertise to tackle practical service building challenges.
Be able to use practical expertise in embedded systems to tackle practical service building issues.

achievementLevels.ideal: Be able to understand what information communication technology is required for the career you are aiming for. In addition, be able to determine your own current level of skills related to those requirements, and make plans for obtaining any skills and qualifications that are lacking.
achievementLevels.standard: Be able to select several careers that meet your inclinations. Be able to understand what information and communication technologies and qualifications are required for those careers. In addition, students must grasp their individual current situation and make acquisition plans to obtain the necessary skills and qualifications.

lessons.assignments: Investigate the human resources required by interested Enterprises.

lessons.assignments: Review the solution development technology and business structure.

 CLIP学習プロセスについて
 一般に、授業あるいは課外での学習では:「知識などを取り込む」→「知識などをいろいろな角度から、場合によってはチーム活動として、考え、推論し、創造する」→「修得した内容を表現、発表、伝達する」→「総合的に評価を受ける、GoodWork!」:のようなプロセス(一部あるいは全体)を繰り返し行いながら、応用力のある知識やスキルを身につけていくことが重要です。このような学習プロセスを大事に行動してください。
